welcome: Welcome to LocalJobs. Connecting you with nearby verified work.
choose_language: Welcome to LocalJobs. For Telugu press 1. Hindi ke liye 2 dabayein. For English press 3.
choose_category: Choose work: Press 1 for Driver. Press 2 for Construction. Press 3 for Electrician. Press 4 for Cleaner. Press 5 for Shop or Helper.
choose_location: Select area: Press 1 for Uppal. Press 2 for Kukatpally. Press 3 for Dilsukhnagar. Press 4 for Secunderabad. Press 5 for All nearby areas.
searching_jobs: Searching verified jobs near you. Please wait.
job_template: Job {index}: {job_type} required in {locality}. Salary {salary} rupees per {salary_type}. Press 1 if you are interested. Press 2 for next job. Press 9 for main menu.
no_more_jobs: You have reached the end of available jobs in this category. Press 9 to return to main menu or hang up.
no_jobs: No verified jobs found in this category right now. Please press 9 to try another category.
application_success: Thank you! Your interest has been submitted using your phone number. The employer will call you soon. Press 2 to hear more jobs, or 9 for main menu.
application_duplicate: You have already applied for this job. The employer already has your phone number and will contact you. Press 2 for next job, or 9 for main menu.
timeout: We did not receive any input. Please make a selection.
max_retries: Too many invalid attempts. Returning to main menu.
goodbye: Thank you for calling LocalJobs. Good luck with your work search. Goodbye.
